domain: Cross-lane measurement methodology - evaluation-fixture comparability, instrument provenance and spentness
mission: Build and exercise once a minimal machine-readable instrument ledger on existing accepted Graph/Physics/Intel/Runtime evidence to determine whether evaluation fixtures, adaptation history and instrument spentness can be tracked well enough to prevent cross-lane instrument reuse and hidden selection-on-instrument.
question: Can a minimal provenance/spentness ledger mechanically flag known instrument-reuse, post-adaptation and comparability hazards in accepted SPIDER evidence without inventing scientific verdicts?
why_now: Historical CTO #25 created this HIGH-priority cross-lane team after repeated instrument-spending and report/data-drift incidents. It is cheap because it can operate on existing provenance.
why_not_existing_lane: Each lane tracks its own experiments but no lane owns cross-lane evaluation-fixture identity, authorship/adaptation history and spentness semantics.
expected_work_compression_leverage: A useful ledger prevents expensive invalid confirmatory cycles and duplicated forensic archaeology; if it cannot reliably classify existing cases, it should not become orchestration infrastructure.
evidence_inputs: Historical CTO #25 run 32909350978: exact team id, CREATE v1, HIGH, cross-lane measurement-methodology domain.
Historical CTO #25 ledger: instrument-ledger partially owns the instrument-spending cascade.
Run Evidence Memory may be used as radar with evidence_status preserved; it may not upgrade scientific claims.
strongest_null_or_baseline: Current per-lane provenance fields/manual ledger review. The new ledger must catch a preregistered set of already-known provenance/spentness hazards with no false scientific reclassification and with lower lookup ambiguity than manual status quo.
validity_threats: Encoding the known answers manually rather than deriving them from durable provenance.
Treating missing provenance as clean provenance instead of UNKNOWN.
Changing or summarizing away original evidence status/verdicts.
Creating more orchestration burden than the forensic work it removes.
required_artifacts: Minimal ledger schema with UNKNOWN-safe semantics.
One-time backfill of a preregistered sample across at least three lanes.
Mechanical hazard checks and comparison against manual baseline.
One-shot verdict on whether the ledger is worth retaining; no automatic deployment.
stop_condition: Stop after one backfill/check/audit cycle. The batch does not authorize making the ledger mandatory infrastructure or auto-continuing the team.
